scope: Static reconstruction of prior RFC6902/$dom and $obj evidence; not functional replay
limits: S01-S03 patch applicability and object references checked; these files do not provide an original canonical hash, so this does not prove pre-dedup equality
S04-S05 expanded run hashes compare original stored canonical digest; semantic paired eligibility and observability are separate

methods: RFC6902 add/remove/replace with strict object and array paths; time set before each patch

S04/S05 sole $obj references expanded recursively; sorted UTF-8 Python default separators used for stored digest
